title: About Me
---

Hello! Welcome to my personal website! This space serves as an introduction to who I am, highlighting my academic journey, professional experiences, and research interests. Here, you can browse my research paper publications, access loads of assignments from my graduate courses and explore projects collaboration with my friends. You can even leave comment or reviews of what you thoughts for my works or any new ideas pop up in your mind! The site is designed not only to showcase my projects and research for professors, colleagues, and collaborators but also to reflect my dedication to learning, data-driven research, and knowledge sharing.
